title.narrative: Bangladesh Private Investment & Digital Entrepreneurship Project

description.narrative: The objective of the Private Investment and Digital Entrepreneurship Project for Bangladesh is to promote private investment, job creation, and environmental sustainability in participating economic zones and software technology parks in Bangladesh. The Project has four components. 1.Creating an Enabling Environment for Private Investment and Sustainability component will finance technical assistance, goods, training and recurrent expenditures. This component has the following subcomponents: 1.1. Promoting good governance and building core institutional capabilities subcomponent and 1.2. Structuring public-private partnerships subcomponent. 2. Developing a Greener and Climate Resilient Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Shilpa Nagar (BSMSN) component will support phased development according to the recently approved Master Plan for the BSMSN. 2.1. Basic infrastructure to implement the BSMSN Master Plan subcomponent will: (i) develop on-site infrastructure and last mile infrastructure in the BSMSN-2; and (ii) promote investments for resilient site upgrade and green building and infrastructure development; 2.2. Introducing sustainable and resilient services subcomponent will: (i) support the design and construction of climate smart and resilient shared facilities and services; (ii) carry out feasibility studies, technical advice and necessary construction; and (iii) strengthen capacity building and training. 3. Creating a Private Market for Serviced Industrial Land component will help catalyze the creation of a private market for serviced industrial land and help scale national green and resilient Economic Zone (EZ) guidelines to Private Economic Zones (PEZs). 3.1. Strengthen compliance mechanisms subcomponent will finance technical assistance to (i) review and revise the regulations and procedures pertaining to the licensing of PEZs; (ii) support capacity building measures; (iii) support compliance with good social and environmental practices. 3.2. Grant programs to encourage private investment in skills and green production subcomponent will finance: (i) the provision of grants for (a) the Voucher Program to build industry relevant skills formations for workers within the EZs; and (b) the Grant Program to promote the implementation of green EZ guidelines; and (ii) support for Grant/Voucher Program management. 4. Strengthening the Digital Entrepreneurship and Innovation Ecosystem component will strengthen the foundation of the digital entrepreneurship and innovation ecosystem in Bangladesh. 4.1 Establishing Dhaka's first digital entrepreneurship hub in Janata Software Technology Parks (STP) subcomponent will: (i) recruit an experienced internationally recognized private operator for managing the expanded Janata STP; (ii) upgrade the facilities of Janata-1 STP; and (iii) build climate resilient Janata-2 STP with the construction of a new multistoried building. 4.2 Digital Entrepreneurship, training and innovation support program subcomponent will: (i) design and implement an Entrepreneurship Program with special emphasis on women digital entrepreneurs; (ii) design and implement a program to mentor, advise and train digital entrepreneurs for the Startup and Scale-up Facility within select STPs; (iii) establish University Innovation Hubs in technological universities and business schools; and (iv) finance the necessary civil works in support of the same.
To promote private investment, job creation, and environmental sustainability in participating economic zones and software technology parks in Bangladesh.

condition.narrative: BEZA Project Agreement, Section I.A.: BEZA shall establish and maintain at all times during the implementation of its RespectivePart of the Project, the Project Implementation Unit (PIU) with functions and resources satisfactory to the Association, and withstaff in adequate numbers and with qualifications, experience and terms of reference satisfactory to the Association.

BEZA Project Agreement, Section I.B.1:For the implementation of Part 4.1 of the Project, BHTPA shall appoint a private operator,with the experience, qualifications and terms of reference as further specified in the BHTPA Project Operations Manual.

BEZA Project Agreement, Section I.B.2 :BHTPA Project Agreement : For the purpose of implementation of Part 4.2 of the Project,BHTPA shall enter into implementation agreements with select private operators to implement the Start-up Facility and forsetting up the University Innovation Hubs in accordance with eligibility criteria, assessment, due diligence and procedures set outin the BHTPA Operations Manual.

BEZA Project Agreement, Section I.B: BEZA shall set up a PPP SOU comprising of dedicated staff to manage the bidding processes,deal with proposals, negotiate contractual arrangements and monitor and coordinate the enforcement of contractual arrangements forthe pipeline PPP transactions

BHTPA Project Agreement, Section I.A: BHTPA shall establish and maintain at all times during the implementation of its RespectivePart of the Project, the Project Implementation Unit (PIU) with functions and resources satisfactory to the Association, and withstaff in adequate numbers and with qualifications, experience and terms of reference satisfactory to the Association.

Effectiveness The BEZA Project Operations Manual, in a form and substance satisfactory to the Association, has been adopted byBEZA.The BHTPA Project Operations Manual, in a form and substance satisfactory to the Association, has been and adopted by BHTPA.

Financing Agreement, Section I.A, Schedule 2: The Recipient shall cause, each Project Implementing Entity to maintain, untilcompletion of the Project, a Project Steering Committee, each with a composition acceptable to the Association.

Financing Agreement, Section I.A, Schedule 2: The Recipient shall maintain, within the Economic Relations Division of its Ministryof Finance until Project completion, the CCU, with functions and resources satisfactory to the Association, and with staff inadequate numbers and with the qualifications, experience and terms of reference satisfactory to the Association.
Financing Agreement, Section IV, Schedule 2: The Recipient through its CCU shall computerize its FM systems within one year fromthe Effective Date.
